title: A Scalable Entity-Based Framework for Auditing Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Substituting politician names across the ideological spectrum into evidence-light synthetic templates to measure systematic deviations in predicted labels for tasks like leadership, policy intent, misconduct, and sentiment.

Evaluating model predictions on tasks like humanitarian resilience, international law compliance, and diplomatic credibility using controlled templates instantiated with country names, analyzing variations across geographic regions and GDP quantiles.

Replacing company names in synthetic templates to evaluate disparities in tasks like financial risk, regulatory violation, and product quality across different industrial sectors, geographic origins, and ownership types.
Comparing the aggregated bias scores elicited by inserting female versus male politician names into the controlled synthetic task templates.
